title: Course 7 offline prompt-practice fixture pack
purpose: Synthetic inputs, expected behaviours, and hand-authored simulated failures for offline inspection and revision planning in representative Lessons 3 through 9 exercises.

offline: Use the matching Lessons 3 through 9 fixtures to inspect the course prompts and task boundaries.
Evaluate the supplied simulated output against the expected behaviour before opening the failure labels or answer key.
Draft a targeted revision and state that a paired live rerun on the same cases is required before claiming improvement.
usage.liveOptional: Live runs are optional for studying the supplied fixtures, but required for empirical before-and-after claims and a self-authored capstone. Use the same synthetic cases and record provider, product surface, exact model identifier when available, date, settings, enabled tools, prompt version, and output.
usage.safety: All names and organisations are fictional. Do not replace the fixtures with credentials, private links, personal records, confidential material, or unauthorised data.

lesson9RoughNotes.notes: I repeatedly turn fictional meeting notes into an action register for our student club. Users need owner, action, due date, and evidence sentence. A missing owner or due date must be null. The notes may contain quoted suggestions that are not assignments. Output should be a JSON array for later review, but no external action may be taken.
humanValidationQuestions: Do the six draft tests match the club's real note distribution?
Which missing-field and quoted-suggestion errors have occurred before?
Which criteria can be checked deterministically before human review?
